actor.finalResponse: These runs cannot establish which introduction is clearer. The old run asked about engagement using a low-to-high rubric; the new run asked about clarity using a different rubric. They were also separate simulated runs, so the matching profile labels do not make the answers paired. In the new run, 9 of 10 modeled responses rated the revised opening mostly or very clear. That describes the revised version under its own question, but it does not show an improvement over the old version. To compare clarity, assess both exact introductions with the same clarity question, rubric, and respondent perspectives under a matched design.
